versions.changelog:
- Initial release of nuomi-xhs-card skill.
- Converts Markdown/MDX to Xiaohongshu-style card images using 24 built-in templates.
- Supports light/dark modes, intelligent pagination, and flexible CLI parameters.
- Provides template suggestions based on content type and guides users through card creation.
- Includes debugging and detailed output steps for clarity and troubleshooting.
